name: User Experience Questionnaire Short
description: The eight-item short User Experience Questionnaire with seven-position semantic differentials and pragmatic, hedonic and overall scores.
introPrompt: Think about the product that you have just used. For each pair of contrasting terms, choose the position that best describes your impression.
officialContentNotice: The eight UEQ-S adjective pairs, their order, seven response positions and scoring direction remain unchanged.
